five_day_thesis: Spot has advanced $267.20 (+6.4%) over five sessions from $4,151.8 to $4,419.0, printing higher in four of five. The defining change is dealer positioning: net window GEX built 5.6× from +79.11 to +443.55 while the gamma flip strike marched $3,345 → $3,540 (+$195), so the level beneath which moves amplify has risen in lockstep with price. ATM IV expanded +1.24pp (21.36% → 22.60%) rather than compressing into the rally — the book is paying up for upside convexity, which argues against selling premium here. Headline max pain has been frozen at $6,500 for all five sessions, an artifact of deep legacy call OI; the tradeable ±25%-window max pain is $4,325, and spot has now cleared it by $94. P/C OI is unmoved at 0.33 → 0.34, confirming a call-dominated book at 2.94:1 where the structural risk is a squeeze into the $4,500 wall, not a put-driven flush.
